sections.title: One noun, three actions
sections.content: You already know időpont ("appointment, time slot") from way back, and foglal ("to book") from booking hotel rooms. The same pair — időpontot foglalni — works for any appointment: a doctor, a class, anything with a specific time. Two new verbs give you the rest of the picture: módosít ("to modify, to change") and lemond ("to cancel"). All three pair with szeretnék + infinitive, the polite request pattern you already use everywhere.

sections.title: Three things you can do with an appointment

items.spanish: Szeretnék egy időpontot foglalni jövő szerdára.
items.english: I'd like to book an appointment for next Wednesday.

items.spanish: Szeretnék lemondani egy időpontot, mert beteg vagyok.
items.english: I'd like to cancel an appointment, because I'm sick.

sections.content: módosítani and lemondani both take egy időpontot as their object, exactly the way foglalni does — once you know one, the other two slot into the same szeretnék + infinitive pattern with no extra grammar to learn.
